Executable.description: How the client runs the asset (ADR-0054 decision 5). The client builds the argv as the runtime's own executable, then entry, then args, and spawns it without a shell; no field holds a command string. runtime is a vetted token, never an executable path, so a shell or an absolute path cannot be named.

runtime.description: The runtime, from the fixed allowlist of vetted tokens; the client maps it to an executable. Widening it is a reviewed change to this schema, not a pack edit.
runtime.title: Runtime

min_version.description: The lowest runtime version the asset needs, as dotted numbers.
min_version.title: Min Version

entry.description: A payload file of the same pack, relative to its assets/ directory: the asset's own or another's. The load checks that the pack holds it (ADR-0054 decision 5 as amended on 2026-11-03). No absolute path, no .. or hidden segment, no whitespace or backslash.
entry.title: Entry

args.description: The arguments after entry, each one argv element. entry is not repeated among them.
args.title: Args

Executable.title: Executable

description:
Sidecar manifest describing one ASSET blob.

Fields
------
id:
    Stable artifact identifier, unique per pack per kind (global
    cross-pack uniqueness is enforced separately by the merge scan, not
    here).
mime:
    Declared MIME type of the referenced blob, e.g. ``"image/png"``.
    Shape (``type/subtype``) and consistency with ``path``'s extension
    are validated by the pack validator, not here.
path:
    Path to the blob, relative to the pack's ``assets/`` directory.
    Containment (no absolute path, no ``..`` escape, no symlink escape)
    is enforced by the pack validator, not here.
title:
    Optional human-facing display name.
executable:
    Optional. Declares that the asset runs (ADR-0054 decision 5): the runtime from a
    fixed allowlist, the entry (a payload file of the same pack, one argv element), and
    the arguments after it. Only an asset with this block can implement a guard.

id.description: One lowercase kebab-case segment of at most 64 characters, the pattern a skill id has: no slash, no upper case, no newline (FR-006 of slice A2).
id.title: Id

title: AssetManifest
